releaseNotes: Fixes the installer resetting the database connection and firm settings on every update, the IT/Audit filing detail dialog's Fetch button offering placeholder values instead of real portal data, a crash opening the IT, Audit, TDS, Other or Certificate fee pages, the dashboard drill-down into GST loading a blank financial year, and the GST fees tab showing for clients with no GST work. Adds GST bulk fetch without portal login, a client-wise summary on the bulk update grid, and multi-select in chat.
